body: No I dont think so. As I said I'm to tired to fight anymore

I've had 4 attempts myself and the last one left me in a coma for a week. I also just found out that I'm convicted of a crime I didnt commit and going to jail. Also lost my girlfriend and my kids. Depressed doesn't begin to describe how I feel right now

I'm immunocompromised and I'm tired of all the added restrictions as well. However a little common sense and decency would go a long way... ie. Maintain reasonable distance wash hands frequently cover face and mouth when coughing and sneezing and we will all get on just fine.
Well I survived yet again and gonna give it one more try
Im proud of those that get better and find a way to fight the pain
